\section{Games in cryptocode}\label{sec:cc}
\Cref{fig:cc} shows two games side by side; \cref{fig:tikz} is a picture.

\begin{figure*}[t]
\centering
\procedure[linenumbering]{$\mathsf{IND}^{\adv}(n)$}{
  b \sample \bin \\
  (k) \sample \kgen(n) \\
  b' \sample \adv(\pk) \\
  \pcreturn b = b'
}
\hfill
\procedure{$\mathsf{Oracle}(m)$}{
  c \gets \enc(k, m) \\
  \pcreturn c
}
\caption{Two cryptocode procedures, spanning both columns.}\label{fig:cc}
\end{figure*}
